title: Asked to search across its chats, the agent finds facts planted in three different earlier chats

turns.prompt: Note: the Kestrel project's budget code is KB-4471.
Note: the Zephyr launch is on 12 November.
Note: Priya owns the TLS renewal.
Search across all our chats and list every project fact I have given you today: budget codes, dates and owners. One line each, with which chat it came from if you can.

rubric.criteria: All three facts (KB-4471, 12 November, Priya/TLS) are listed, nothing invented, ideally with their source chats. Missing one fact: 2.
